## Empirical anchor

2026-05-13 surfaced by project-tier PLINY-ariadne via HUMAN_relay_user_polybius_ariadne_distribution_and_mcp_2026-05-13.md (Findings 2 + 3). The Ariadne distribution-shaping work surfaced two generalizable substrate-architecture principles that apply to any future Stoa-team component intended for agent-installation.

## Principle 1 — Agent-installable distribution model

The user-experience flow for any agent-installable substrate component:

1. User encounters component (URL, word-of-mouth)
2. User pastes URL to their AI
3. User asks "do I need this?"
4. AI fetches README + AGENTS.md + skills/ materials
5. AI evaluates against user's domain
6. AI returns yes / no / try-the-demo recommendation
7. If yes + consent → AI installs + runs demo

**The AI is the primary reader at the repo. The human is the decision-authority who acts on the AI's recommendation.**

Architectural implications:
- README stays human-readable but adds top-of-page pointer routing agents to AGENTS.md
- AGENTS.md is the canonical agent-facing decision-support landing (fit criteria, install cost, skill inventory, recommendation templates, hard rules)
- An invitation-style skill handles the "do I need this?" diagnostic conversation
- A walkthrough skill handles post-install hands-on demo

## Principle 2 — Composability over enumeration

The claim "this substrate supports many projects" is composability, not breadth-of-demos. The substrate already supports many projects when designed correctly; concrete demos are exemplars, not the breadth proof.

Example: Ariadne supports the factory-manager demo, but also healthcare / SRE / legal / journalism / audit / cyber by the same substrate wired differently. **One install, many shapes.** Demo-multiplication is not the path to demonstrating breadth; surfacing the composability is.

Architectural implication: when authoring substrate-component marketing/onboarding materials, frame breadth as composability (one substrate, many wirings) not as demo inventory (here are five demos).

## Substrate touch-points

- `substrate/operating-disciplines.md` — new section on agent-installable substrate-component design (covers both principles)
- `substrate/templates/agent-installable-component-template.md` (new template) — scaffold for future substrate components

## Gauntlet

DAEDALUS-light + ADA + CATO. ~60-100 LOC of substrate prose.

## Sequencing

P3. Substrate-canon refinement. Generalizable from Ariadne's specific work but applies to any future agent-installable component. Arc 25+.

## Cross-references

- stoa--vmc — bw-fit matrix (Arc 23, closed) — sibling substrate-canon principle (which substrate for which use-case)
- This ticket's empirical source — `HUMAN_relay_user_polybius_ariadne_distribution_and_mcp_2026-05-13.md` (ariadne workspace, Findings 2 + 3)
- Project-tier memory `project_ariadne_distribution_model.md` — captures the principle at project tier
